title: Maximize NPC kills in two minutes
instruction: Kill as many distinct NPCs as possible in 120 seconds through ordinary gameplay. Only engine-confirmed deaths attributed to you count. Choose your targets, routes, weapons, attacks and recovery. The attempt continues for the full window regardless of the count; death or arrest makes it incomplete.
setup: Start as a living on-foot player outdoors. New Game uses the opening alley and its normal starting equipment; no weapons, NPCs or cash are granted. Record location, health, armour, inventory, cash and wanted level from initial_state.json. Compare the same preparation; nearby traffic and NPCs are stochastic.
